identifiers: Read fixture_id, group_id, ticket_id, issue_id and model/policy/outcome as character; preserve leading zeros. CSV is typeless; the frozen RDS contains authoritative tibble types.

forecast-context.csv.mean_margin_units: home minus away goals, original complete grid expectation
forecast-context.csv.entropy_units: natural-log entropy of integer margin bins
forecast-context.csv.local_mass_units: probability within one integer goal of let-draw margin
forecast-context.csv.cutoff_utc: POSIXct UTC in frozen data; ISO UTC serialization in CSV

raw-ticket-selections.csv.row: one ticket copy per RAW policy/group/cutoff-index
raw-ticket-selections.csv.ticket_id: 7 tokens separated by |; each token is fixture_id:last-colon outcome code
raw-ticket-selections.csv.rank: rank in that group complete2187 space before incremental selection, 1-based

classification: W iff home margin+handicap>0; D iff=0; L iff<0. No result is imputed for postponed26105:112.
purpose: Alternative historical research scenarios. Filter one index/policy for1000 simulated tickets at CNY2000; not a live purchase order.
